turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: This is the bank calling to remind you about your branch appointment on Tuesday.

turns.speaker: elder
turns.text: Thank you, what time is it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is at ten. Please bring your identification to the branch.

turns.speaker: elder
turns.text: All right, I will be there.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Thank you. We will not ask for money, passwords, or codes by phone.
